name: connector_sources
description:
List the company databases declared on the stand: each source's name, engine (mongodb, sqlserver or postgresql), database, the collections
an agent may read and what a person wrote about it. Start here, then read a source's shape with connector_schema.

name: connector_schema
description:
Read what a source holds before querying it. Without a collection: the collections an agent may read. With one:
its fields read from a sample of 200 documents — each field's dotted path, its types, how often it is present and
an example value — the documents it holds and its indexes, which are what a filter is quick on.

source.description: The source's name, as connector_sources lists it.

collection.description: The collection whose fields to read; without one, the collections an agent may read.

name: connector_find
description:
Read documents of a collection that match a filter, with the fields and order asked for. Write the filter,
projection and sort as MongoDB Extended JSON, such as {"status": "paid", "total": {"$gt": 100}}; dates as {"$date": "2026-01-31T00:00:00Z"}, ids as {"$oid": "…"}. An answer carries 50 documents unless asked for more, at most 200, and at
most 65536 bytes of them; when it was cut it says so — narrow the filter or count first. A query gets 30 seconds.
Only reads: operators that write or run code are refused.

source.description: The source's name, as connector_sources lists it.

collection.description: The collection, as connector_schema lists it.

filter.description: Which documents, as MongoDB Extended JSON, such as {"status": "paid", "total": {"$gt": 100}}; dates as {"$date": "2026-01-31T00:00:00Z"}, ids as {"$oid": "…"}; empty matches every one.

projection.description: Which fields to return, such as {"number": 1, "total": 1, "_id": 0}; empty returns them all.

sort.description: The order, such as {"date": -1}; empty leaves the database's order.

limit.description: How many rows to return: 50 when not given, at most 200.

name: connector_aggregate
description:
Run a MongoDB aggregation pipeline on a collection to group, sum, count and join — the way to analyse rather than
list. Write the pipeline as a JSON array of stages in MongoDB Extended JSON, such as {"status": "paid", "total": {"$gt": 100}}; dates as {"$date": "2026-01-31T00:00:00Z"}, ids as {"$oid": "…"}. $lookup, $graphLookup and $unionWith may
read only collections the source allows; $out, $merge, $function, $accumulator and $where are refused. The answer
carries 50 rows unless asked for more, at most 200, at most 65536 bytes; a query gets 30 seconds.

source.description: The source's name, as connector_sources lists it.

collection.description: The collection, as connector_schema lists it.

pipeline.description: The stages as a JSON array, such as [{"$match": {"status": "paid"}}, {"$group": {"_id": "$customer", "total": {"$sum": "$total"}}}].

limit.description: How many rows to return: 50 when not given, at most 200.

name: connector_count
description:
Count the documents of a collection that match a filter, written as MongoDB Extended JSON, such as {"status": "paid", "total": {"$gt": 100}}; dates as {"$date": "2026-01-31T00:00:00Z"}, ids as {"$oid": "…"}; an empty filter counts them
all. Cheaper than reading them: count before reading a large collection.

source.description: The source's name, as connector_sources lists it.

collection.description: The collection, as connector_schema lists it.

filter.description: Which documents, as MongoDB Extended JSON, such as {"status": "paid", "total": {"$gt": 100}}; dates as {"$date": "2026-01-31T00:00:00Z"}, ids as {"$oid": "…"}; empty matches every one.

name: connector_export
description:
Write the documents of a filter, or the rows of a pipeline, into a csv or xlsx file of the task, under exports/ of
the working copy, so a person gets the data as a table. Give either a filter or a pipeline. Nested fields become
columns of their dotted paths. An export writes at most 100000 rows and says when it stopped there.

source.description: The source's name, as connector_sources lists it.

collection.description: The collection, as connector_schema lists it.

format.description: The file's format: csv or xlsx.

file.description: The file's name, letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores; the format's extension is added when missing.

filter.description: Which documents, as MongoDB Extended JSON, such as {"status": "paid", "total": {"$gt": 100}}; dates as {"$date": "2026-01-31T00:00:00Z"}, ids as {"$oid": "…"}; empty matches every one.

pipeline.description: The stages as a JSON array, when the rows come from a pipeline rather than a filter.

name: connector_journal
description:
Read the queries this task already made — which source and collection, what was asked, how many rows came back,
whether it failed — newest first, so a query is not repeated. Every query is written there, for the company to see.

most.description: How many queries to return, newest first: at most 200.

name: connector_propose_write
description:
Propose a change to a company database — update, update_one, insert or delete — when the task needs one. Nothing is written: the server
dry-runs it as the read-only user, counts the documents it touches and keeps a few of them as they are now, and
answers a proposal id. Then call request_write_approval with server "connector" and that proposal: the task waits
until the stand's owner reads the proposal and allows or refuses it. An update or a delete needs a filter naming
the documents; an update is field operators such as $set; one proposal touches at most 1000 documents. The source
must have a writing user.

source.description: The source's name, as connector_sources lists it.

collection.description: The collection, as connector_schema lists it.

operation.description: What the write does: update, update_one, insert or delete.

reason.description: Why the task needs this write, in one or two sentences for the person who decides.

filter.description: Which documents an update or a delete touches, such as {"number": "2026-0042"}; it may not be empty. Not used by an insert.

change.description: For an update, the field operators, such as {"$set": {"status": "paid"}}; for an insert, a JSON array of the documents; not used by a delete.

name: connector_apply
description:
Run a proposal the stand's owner allowed, once, as the source's writing user, and get back how many documents it
changed. Only the task that proposed it may run it, and only within 7 days; a proposal nobody allowed yet, refused,
or already run is refused with what to do.

name: connector_diagnose
description: Say whether the server can reach the stand's sources: its version, Vault, and how many sources are declared. Changes nothing.
